messages:
Alex: Heads-up — PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/40421 needs cross-team approvals (runtime, platform, infra, security). Merge window tomorrow 10:00 PT. Can people pinged below take a look?

Priya: I'll do platform review. Which parts to focus on?

Alex: Thanks. Focus on orchestration changes (handlers/orch/*), rollout flags, and the new autoscaler config. Also note the KV eviction default change and batching tweak. Quick diff:
```
files changed: handlers/orch/scheduler.go, runtime/kv/evict.go, infra/batching/config.yaml
```

Marco: On it — I'll review runtime perf and kv cache edgecases. ETA ~2h. If perf reg, we should fallback to previous kernel.

Tina: I can eyeball infra constraints later today, but I need an owners list for the infra-facing config in infra/batching/config.yaml. @infra-oncall can you chime in?

Jordan: EngSRE here — can we get a canary plan? I need a quick checklist: canary cluster, traffic split, rollback playbook. Without that I won't sign off on rollout.

sec-bot: Security scan: SCA + static analysis passed. Manual review required for KMS/HSM usage around runtime/keys.go. Tagging sec-team.

Priya: Got it. I'll validate orchestration logic and confirm that feature flags are gated. Also will run the e2e orchestration job locally and post results.

Marco: Found one potential N+1 in scheduler.go path when prefix cache miss occurs. Small patch incoming in the PR comments.

Alex: Appreciated. @sec-team — can someone do a quick manual check on runtime/keys.go? It's about key wrapping when caching tokens.

Sam: I'll take it, give me ~3h.

Tina: infra note — need to update infra/README for the batching defaults. I'll prepare a short changelog entry for release notes.

Priya: e2e orchestration job passed locally (logs attached). I left a couple of small nits but nothing blocking.

Jordan: Canary plan: rolling 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 2h intervals, monitor latency and tail QPS. I'll create a canary runbook PR and link it here.

Alex: Awesome. Plan for merge: if runtime + platform + infra + sec signoffs are in before 10:00 PT tomorrow, I will merge in the window. Otherwise we hold to the next slot.

Marco: +1 from runtime after my patch.

Priya: +1 from platform (flags gated, e2e green).

Sam: +1 from security manual check (KMS usage approved, recorded in ticket SEC-2717).

Tina: +1 infra (docs + changelog updated in PR).

Alex: All set — merging in the 10:00 PT window. Thanks everyone :tada: If anything pops, ping me directly.

deploy-bot: Scheduled merge at 2024-09-03T10:00:00-07:00 by @alex — CI passed, release notes link: https://internal/redwood/releases/40421

Alex: merged and rollout started. Monitoring. :shipit:
